'''Sports'''
*[[2026 NBA Finals]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[New York Knicks]] [[Comeback (sports)|rally]] from a 29-point deficit to beat the [[San Antonio Spurs]] 107–106 in [[2026 NBA Finals#Game 4|Game 4]], taking a 3–1 series lead in the [[NBA Finals]] after [[OG Anunoby]] tipped in the game-winning basket with 1.2 seconds remaining. The [[List of largest comebacks in NBA games|comeback is the largest]] in [[List of NBA postseason records#NBA Finals records|NBA Finals history]], surpassing the [[Boston Celtics]]' 24-point comeback in Game 4 of the [[2008 NBA Finals|2008 finals]].
